title: Too little product for too much money...
text:
Even at an introductory 50% off the normal price, this is far from a good deal. Judge for yourself.

Since products are not labeled to disclose what is in the package, I've made a best guess.

$29.99 small dog box:
3 ea lamb's ears
1 ea cow's ear
2 ea tendons
2 small braided bully
3 crunchy things
label: negative
